text:
clare_marketing: Heads-up: we confirmed NimbusHealth as a customer spotlight for next sprint. Need quote + legal ok + webinar routing. Interview Thu 11am PT. Legal needs final quote by Wed EOD. Who can own?
caleb_content: Ill draft 3 quote variants today and add a consent template. Will paste in the doc: https://docs.google.com/draft/nimbus-spotlight (private).
amy_legal: Please avoid vague phrasing like '~' and superlatives unless backed by data. We need explicit email approval from the customer for any attributable quote. Add embargo dates in the consent text.
jamal_prod: Bench snapshot to back numbers: 
```
model: redwood-v1-small
hw: 2xT4
seq: 512
p95 latency before: 120ms -> after: 45ms (2.67x)
cost per token estimate: $0.00020 -> $0.00012 (40% reduction)
```
I'll put the harness link + run date in the doc.
sylvie_sales: For webinar routing, route registrants who select "Evaluating vendors" to SF campaign NIMBUS_Q3 and tag AEs. I'll create the form gating question.
clare_marketing: Timeline: today - Caleb drafts quotes & consent; Wed morning - legal redlines; Wed EOD - customer approval; Thu 11am - interview. Any blockers?
caleb_content: No blockers. I'll ping the customer and @amy_legal once they reply.
amy_legal: Copy that
